data.gender_notes: Naashirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root nasara which means 'to help, support, assist'. In Islamic tradition, the name Naashirah is given to a girl who is believed to be a helper or supporter in her family and community. The name Naashirah carries the meaning “Helper, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naashirah usually hope their child will grow to embody helper, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolic of support and assistance in the path of righteousness.
data.etymology: Naashirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper, Supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naashirah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Naashirah can be seen as a reminder of the importance of being a source of support and comfort for others. Muslims believe that helping and assisting others is an essential part of leading a virtuous life. By giving the name Naashirah to a girl, parents are encouraging her to embody this Islamic virtue and be a helper and supporter in all aspects of her life, both within her family and in her wider community. Additionally, the name Naashirah can be seen as a reminder of the role played by God in providing support and guidance to his creation. Just as a helper or supporter plays an essential role in the lives of others, so too does God provide His endless support and guidance to us. Thus, the name Naashirah carries both a cultural and spiritual significance as a reminder of the importance of supporting and helping others, and the role of God as the ultimate source of support and guidance.
